spans.s:
√mnā 'note'
present: [1.] manati etc. S.+ manate -- [2.] mnāyus 
[perfect: mamnau ]
aorist: [1.] mnāyāt mneyāt -- [6.] amnāsiṣus 
[future: mnāsyati mnātā ]
verbal: mnāta S.+ 
secondary: passive: mnāyate -- intensive: māmnā- -- desiderative: mimnāsa- -- causative: mnāpaya- amimnapat 
derivatives: -mnāna S.+ -mnātavya C. -mnāya S.+ 
Only with prefix ā: a secondary root-form from √man - to which, indeed, the forms from stem mana- more properly belong.
